frameText: The first paragraph fills seven of the eight lines in the first frame with ordinary running words and nothing else at all, which takes a fair number of words when each line holds only five or six of them.
Default orphans of two: only one line of this paragraph would fit, so the whole paragraph starts in the next frame. Default widows of two: this paragraph would leave a single
line behind, so one more line moves along with it now. Orphans and widows of three: this paragraph is split so that at least three lines stay on either side of the break between frames, which needs a
paragraph of about eight lines in all to show the rule clearly at work in this fixture.
